svg.title: Vacuum / dry-nitrogen purge sequence
svg.desc: Vacuum / dry-nitrogen purge sequence. Pressure: 1 mbar Initial vacuum duration: 1 min Total purge count: 3 cycles Environment: Alternating vacuum and dry nitrogen, as explicitly reported.; Explicit atmosphere already present in source and operation description; resolved default missingness contradiction. At 120 C, first vacuum for one minute, then dry nitrogen and vacuum. Source total is three purges. Conceptual material flow. Shapes do not represent apparatus geometry, liquid levels or measured particle structure.
